content: Amenɣi ak-d Aram x Ramut di Jilɛad
Třata n iseggʷusa ḥḍan nitni řhudnet, war din tuɣi amenɣi jar Aram d Israil.
Deg useggʷas wiss třata, řami dd-ihwa Yahucafaṭ, ajeǧid n Yahuda, ɣar ujeǧid n Israil, imsar,
aqa ajeǧid n Israil inna i imsexxaren nnes: “Ma tessnem aqa Ramut di Jilɛad nneɣ? Ma ittxeṣṣa aneɣ ad neḥḍa řhudnet, war ten nᵉttekkes zeg ufus n ujeǧid n Aram?”
Xas uca inna i Yahucafaṭ “Zeɛma ad kidi teffɣed ɣar umenɣi ak-d Ramut di Jilɛad?” Inna Yahucafaṭ i ujeǧid n Israil: “Necc ad iřiɣ am cek, řgens inu am řgens nnec, iysan inu am yeysan nnec.”
Inna Yahucafaṭ ɛawed i ujeǧid n Israil: “Seqsa ɛafak ass-a x wawař n SIDI.”

Xenni issmun ujeǧid n Israil inabiyyen, ɛřaḥař arebɛa-mya n yeryazen, inna asen: “Ma ad ffɣeɣ ɣar umenɣi ɣar Ramut di Jilɛad niɣ ad t jjeɣ?” Nitni nnan: “Geɛɛed, maɣar Sidi inu ad ten iwc deg ufus n ujeǧid.”
Maca Yahucafaṭ inna: “Ma war da ca ijj n unabi n SIDI, maḥend ad nzemmar ad t nesseqsa neccin?”

Xenni inna ujeǧid n Israil i Yahucafaṭ: “Aqa ɛad da ijj n weryaz i zzayes nzemmar ad nesseqsa SIDI. Maca necc carheɣ t, maɣar netta war d ayi ittnebba ɛemmarṣ s min iṣebḥen, maca mɣir s min iǧan d aɛeffan. Aqa-t d Mixa-Yahu, mmis n Yimla.” Inna Yahucafaṭ: “War iǧi ammu i ɣa issiweř ajeǧid!”
Xenni iřaɣa-dd ujeǧid n Israil i yijj n umsexxar amcenneɛ, inna: “Deɣya, awi-dd Mixa-Yahu, mmis n Yimla!”

Ajeǧid n Israil d Yahucafaṭ, ajeǧid n Yahuda, qqimen din, kuř ijj x řɛarc nnes, yarḍen s warruḍ n ijeǧiden x wazzay n unedrar ɣar uqemmum n tewwart n tendint n Samarya u marra inabiyyen tuɣa ttnebban zzat i wudem nsen.
Ṣidqiya, mmis n Kanɛana, tuɣa igga i ixef nnes accawen n wuzzař, inna: “Ammu i inna SIDI: ‘S yina i ɣa tessnuqqbed ayt n Aram ař ten ɣa teqḍiḍ.’”
Marra inabiyyen tuɣa ttnebban kifkif, nnan: “Geɛɛed ɣar Ramut di Jilɛad, ad tiřid tfeřḥed, minzi SIDI ad ten iwc deg ufus n ujeǧid.”

Areqqas nni tuɣa iṭṭfen abrid, ḥima ad iřaɣa i Mixa-Yahu, issiweř, inna:“Xzar xenni, awařen n inabiyyen axmi dd-ffɣen zeg ijj n uqemmum s řxir ɣar ujeǧid. Ttzawgeɣ ad iřin wawařen nnec am wawařen nsen, siweř min iṣebḥen.”
Maca Mixa-Yahu inna: “S tidett am iddar SIDI, min d ayi ɣa yini SIDI, ad t iniɣ.”
Umi dd-yusa ɣar ujeǧid, inna as ujeǧid: “Mixa-Yahu, ma ad neffeɣ neccin ɣar Ramut di Jilɛad niɣ ad t nejj?” Inna as netta: “Geɛɛed, ad tiřid tfeřḥed, minzi SIDI ad ten iwc deg ufus n ujeǧid.”
Inna as ujeǧid: “Mecḥař n twařawin ittxeṣṣa ayi ad cek ssjaǧeɣ, war d ayi tennid mɣir tidett deg Yisem n SIDI?”
Uca netta inna: “Necc ẓriɣ marra Israil ttwabezzɛen x idurar am wuǧi war ɣarsen bu umeksaw. Inna SIDI: ‘Ina war ɣarsen bu isiditen, ejj kuř aryaz ad dd-idweř ɣar taddart nnes di řehna.’”
Xenni inna ujeǧid n Israil i Yahucafaṭ: “Ma war d ac nniɣ: ‘Netta ittnebba xafi walu n min iṣebḥen, mɣir min iǧan d aɛeffan?’”
Xas uca inna wanita: “S uya seř i wawař n SIDI. Necc ẓriɣ SIDI iqqim x řɛarc d marra řɛeskar n ujenna ibedd ɣares, ɣar yefus nnes u ɣar uzeřmaḍ nnes.
SIDI inna: ‘Man wen i ɣa iɣwan Axab ař ɣa igeɛɛed, ad iwḍa di Ramut di Jilɛad?’ Wa inna ammu u win inna ammu.
Xenni iffeɣ-dd ijj n buḥbeř, ibedd zzat i wudem n SIDI, inna: ‘Necc ad t ɣwiɣ.’ SIDI isseqsa t: ‘S minzi?’
Netta inna: ‘Necc ad ffɣeɣ u ad dewřeɣ d ijj n buḥbeř issxarriqen deg uqemmum n marra inabiyyen nnes.’ U netta inna: ‘Ad tfeřḥed maḥend ad t teɣwid. Ffeɣ, egg amenni!’
Xenni řexxu, SIDI iwca ijj n buḥbeř issxarriqen deg ufus n marra inabiyyen nwem uca SIDI ibarreḥ xak s řɣar.”
Xenni iqarreb-dd Ṣidqiya, mmis n Kanɛana, ɣar Mixa-Yahu, iwti t ɣar uɣesmir, inna: “Mani xenni tuɣa zzayi iɛdu Arruḥ n SIDI ḥima ad kidek issiweř?”
Inna Mixa-Yahu: “Xzar, ad t tẓared deg wass nni di ɣa temhafed zeg ijj n wexxam ɣar wexxam nneɣni, ḥima ad tessnuffared ixef nnec.”
Ajeǧid n Israil inna: “Ṭṭfem Mixa-Yahu, nedhem t ɣar Amun, řḥakem n tendint, u ɣar Yuwac, mmis n ujeǧid.
Ad tinid: ‘Ammu i iqqar ujeǧid: Nḍarem wa di řeḥbes u seccem t s weɣrum n řeḥṣaret u s waman n řeḥṣaret ař dd ɣa ɛeqbeɣ di řehna.’”
Mixa-Yahu inna: “Mařa cek tɛeqbed-dd s tidett di řehna, aqa SIDI war zzayi issiweř!” Netta inna ɛawed: “Sřem, řegnus, marra kenniw!”
Xenni igeɛɛed ujeǧid n Israil ak-d Yahucafaṭ, ajeǧid n Yahuda, ɣar Ramut di Jilɛad.
Inna ujeǧid n Israil i Yahucafaṭ: “Necc ad beddřeɣ arruḍ, xenni ad dd-ffɣeɣ ɣar umenɣi. Cek maca tzemmared ad tyarḍed arruḍ nnec!” Ajeǧid n Israil igga arruḍ war iǧi nnes, iffeɣ-dd ɣar umenɣi.
Ajeǧid n Aram tuɣa yumur i řqebṭanat n ikarruten n umenɣi, inni zzaysen ɣares tnayen u-třatin, inna: “Ittxeṣṣa awem war ttmenɣim ak-d umeqqran niɣ ak-d umeẓyan, mɣir ak-d ujeǧid n Israil!”
Umi řqebṭanat n ikarruten n umenɣi ẓrin Yahucafaṭ, imsar, aqa nitni nnan: “Aqa d wa, ajeǧid n Israil!” Nitni meyyřen xas ḥima akides mmenɣen, maca Yahucafaṭ isɣuy.
Umi ẓrin řqebṭanat n ikarruten n umenɣi, aqa netta tuɣa war iǧi d ajeǧid n Israil, imsar, aqa dewřen-dd, war t areddfen ɛad.

Xenni iɛeyyen ijj n weryaz s řqews s řbař nnes d acemřař uca iřqef ajeǧid n Israil jar wawaḍen n warruḍ n wuzzař. Řexdenni inna wanita i wenni ineddhen akarru: “Qřeb afus nnec, suffeɣ ayi zi řɛeskar, maɣar iyzmeɣ aṭṭas.”
Deg wass nni idweř umenɣi yewɛar aṭṭas. Iqqim ujeǧid ibedd deg ukarru deg umenɣi ak-d ayt n Aram, maca ɣar tmeddit immut. Idammen n uyezzim tuɣa uzzřen deg uɛeddis n ukarru.
Ɣar uɣeǧay n tfuct jjin ad barrḥen s jjehd di marra řɛeskar, nnan: “Kuř aryaz ad dd-iɛqeb ɣar tendint nnes u kuř aryaz ɣar temmurt nnes!”
Immut ujeǧid, iwyen t ɣar Samarya. Nitni neḍřen ajeǧid di Samarya.
Ssirden akarru deg uyeřmam n Samarya uca řesḥen iṭan idammen nnes, mani timɣarin n farq-ccɣeř ssirdent dayes, ɛlaḥsab awař n SIDI i tuɣa inna.
Imezruyen iqqimen n Axab, d marra min igga d taddart n řɛaj i ibna d marra tineddam i ibna, ma man aya marra war ittwazemmem ca deg wedlis n imezruyen n ijeǧiden n Israil?
Axab igga ad yareyyeḥ jar řejdud nnes. Mmis Axazya idweř d ajeǧid deg wemcan nnes.
Yahucafaṭ, ajeǧid n Yahuda
Yahucafaṭ, mmis n Asa, idweř d ajeǧid x Israil, deg useggʷas wiss arebɛa n Axab, ajeǧid n Israil.
Yahucafaṭ tuɣa ɣares xemsa u-třatin n iseggʷusa, umi idweř d ajeǧid. Netta iḥkem xemsa u-ɛicrin n iseggʷusa di Urcalim. Yemmas qqaren as Azuba, yeǧis n Calxi.
Netta yuyur di marra tibridin n babas Asa, war xasent iḥeyyed ca. Netta igga min iǧan nican di tiṭṭawin n SIDI.
Řegɛudi war ttwakksent. Řgens yiwi ɛad tiɣarṣa d tewhibin n řebxur x řegɛudi.
Yahucafaṭ iḥḍa x řehna ak-d ujeǧid n Israil.
Imezruyen iqqimen n Yahucafaṭ, d tmegga nnes imeḥḍen i igga d mammec immneɣ, ma man aya marra war ittwazemmem ca deg wedlis n imezruyen n ijeǧiden n Yahuda?
Netta imḥa imetleyyen iqqimen zi temmurt, inni tuɣa iqqimen zeg wussan n babas Asa.
Di Idum war tuɣi din ca n ujeǧid, maca ijj n lwali n ujeǧid.
Yahucafaṭ igga iɣarruba n Tarcic, ḥima ad nedhen ɣar Ufir ad awyen ureɣ. Maca war dd-ffiɣen ca, maɣar iɣarruba arẓin ɣar Ɛiṣyun-Jabar.
Xenni inna Axazya, mmis n Axab, i Yahucafaṭ: “Ejj imsexxaren inu ad nedhen ak-d imsexxaren nnec x iɣarruba!”, maca Yahucafaṭ yugi.
Yahucafaṭ igga ad yareyyeḥ jar řejdud nnes. Netta ittwanḍeř jar řejdud nnes di tendint n babas Dawud. Mmis Yahuram idweř d ajeǧid deg wemcan nnes.
Axazya, ajeǧid n Israil
Axazya, mmis n Axab, idweř d ajeǧid x Israil di Samarya, deg useggʷas wiss sbeɛṭac n Yahucafaṭ, ajeǧid n Yahuda. Netta iḥkem tnayen n iseggʷusa x Israil.
Netta igga min iǧan d aɛeffan di tiṭṭawin n SIDI. Netta yuyur x webrid n babas u x webrid n yemmas u x webrid n Yarubɛam, mmis n Nabaṭ, wenni yarrin Israil ad ixḍa.
Netta iɛbed Baɛl, ibendeq as. Netta isɛar SIDI, AREBBI n Israil, s marra min tuɣa igga babas.
